title: DISA STIG Compliance for Windows 10 & 11 in Microsoft Intune
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (multi-control DoD STIG hardening for Windows 10/11 via Intune settings catalog/ADMX, compliance reporting, drift, and a STIG-release maintenance lifecycle; federal/DoD context, higher assurance).

Sibling in shape to the CIS Benchmark products (net-new + maintenance lifecycle) but delivers the DISA STIG (DoD standard). STIG control IDs/values deferred to the official DISA STIG / STIG Viewer. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Harden Windows 10 & 11 to the DISA STIG in Intune — and keep it compliant as new STIGs release
problem: Defense and federal environments must meet the DISA STIG for Windows, and auditors expect proof. Applying hundreds of STIG rules by hand — and re-checking them every quarter when DISA publishes a new benchmark — is brutal, and manual GPO-era approaches don't follow cloud-managed devices. This solution delivers a repeatable way to implement and continuously manage DISA STIG compliance for Windows 10 and 11 in Microsoft Intune: build the hardened baseline as Intune policy, prove compliance, and run a documented update process each time a new STIG release drops.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what the DISA STIG is, CAT I/II/III severities, how STIG rules map to Intune (settings catalog and imported ADMX) vs. the Microsoft security baselines, the compliance/reporting model, and the STIG-release maintenance lifecycle.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported Windows 10/11, device groups, the official DISA STIG / STIG Viewer / SCAP content, documented exceptions/POA&M process) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide (net-new) — exact, ordered steps: stage the STIG, build the configuration in Intune by severity, handle documented exceptions (POA&M), assign to a pilot, validate compliance, then expand fleet-wide.

Maintenance & Update Guide — a repeatable process for each new STIG release: obtain the new version, diff it against your live baseline, assess and approve changes, update the Intune policies in a controlled change, re-validate, and record the STIG version you are on.

5 PowerShell scripts — STIG-readiness discovery, per-device STIG-compliance validation, a fleet STIG posture and drift report, safe remediation of drifted settings, and a STIG-version comparison helper that diffs a new STIG export against your current baseline.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Implement and continuously manage DISA STIG compliance for Windows 10 and 11 in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened baseline by severity as Intune policy, prove compliance, and update it each time a new STIG releases. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
